To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel approach for a robot control based on the multi modal artificial skin and joint sensor data.
we propose a novel end to end framework to transform multi modal tactile signals (proximity, forces and accelerations) to a compliant control for different dynamic behaviors of a robot.
we present a novel approach to control a robot using multi modal tactile signals and that this approach enables to improve and even change the dynamic robot behaviors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an end to end framework that allows a robot to be more compliant by using multi modal tactile signals.
the development of a compliant control for a wheeled humanoid robot.
the design of a compliant control based on a robot parametric model, which is obtained from the fusion of multi modal sensor signals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we present a framework that transforms multi modal tactile signals from an artificial skin into compliant behaviors.
we present a novel end to end approach that transforms multi modal signals into a compliant behavior to generate different dynamic behaviors for a robotic system.
our framework allows to transform multi modal tactile signals in compliant control, which enables a stiff robotic platform to be compliant and to generate different dynamic behaviors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a new approach to generate different dynamic behaviors for a stiff robot using a compliant control, where the robot is controlled by the artificial skin multi sensor signals.
we present an end-to-end framework to control a robotic system using multi modal tactile signals.
the presented approach is an end to end framework for a compliant control of robots.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a compliant control can be generated using multi modal sensor signals.
the proposed compliant control can be used in different robotic platforms to generate different dynamic behaviors.
we can transform a stiff robot into a compliant robot, by using a multi modal tactile sensor and a parametric modeling of the robot.
